title: Page
description: content/pages/<id>.json: one page, built once per locale at /<locale>/<slug>/. A page is an ordered list of sections.

id.description: Stable page id used by menus and links. "home" and "not-found" are special.

slug.description: URL path without locale or slashes ("" for the home page). Shared by all locales.

order.description: Sort order in the sitemap and builder page list.

title.description: Page name for <title>, breadcrumbs and the builder.

subnav.description: Show sticky on-page navigation built from sections that have navLabel and id.

id.description: Anchor id (#id). Required when menus, page navigation or links point to the section.

navLabel.description: Label in the on-page navigation (pages with subnav: true).

hidden.description: Keep in the data but do not render.

divider.description: Thin ornamental rule above the section.

id.description: Anchor id (#id). Required when menus, page navigation or links point to the section.

navLabel.description: Label in the on-page navigation (pages with subnav: true).

hidden.description: Keep in the data but do not render.

section-hero.title: Hero

nextServices.description: Card listing the next N services from services.json.
